claim: The demo loads sample data separately from a real card and can be reset.
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo, observes sample data and banner, resets it, then starts a real empty card.

claim: Health records stay in the browser during normal use.
where: Home privacy fact, footer, Privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow records every request while an example medicine is edited; all requests are same-origin.

claim: The card works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo once, waits for the active service worker, goes offline, and reloads the sample card.

claim: A plain JSON backup can be downloaded and restored.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow downloads JSON, uploads a valid backup, accepts the replacement confirmation, and observes restored data.

claim: The current list appears on a one-page print/PDF handoff card.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow switches to print media and asserts that the sample medicine and safety note are in the printable card.

claim: Keyboard Tab focus stays inside an open medicine dialog.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow opens a medicine editor, tabs forward through all controls, reverse-tabs once, and asserts focus remains in the dialog.

claim: A verified one-time license enables a passphrase-protected backup.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow stubs a valid Sociobot license response, downloads the encrypted backup, and asserts its encrypted format does not expose a sample medicine.
